messages:
elaine: quick help — 2pm slot today for Backend Infra (senior) needs coverage, candidate A. can someone pick this up? also small rubric Q: for onsite vs takehome, do we keep system design at 35% or bump it? pinging @samir for a quick PR review too: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/842 — small docs change for scribe flow. need coverage + rubric clarity + PR ping. thanks!

samir: i can cover 2pm if it's remote/zoom. i have a deploy at 1:30 but can jump in after smoke tests. @michael any concerns if i step in as interviewer?

anya: i can standby as backup. FYI i updated the debrief template earlier today — added a checkbox for "whiteboard limited" and a short prompt for time-constrained candidates: https://docs.redwood.com/interview/debrief

michael: agree with @anya on the template. rubric quick answer: use 35% design / 40% implementation / 25% communication for onsite. for takehome, implementation becomes 50% and design drops — but for this role keep the standard onsite weights. so 35/40/25 for today's slot.

elaine: noted — role is Backend Infra (senior). @samir can you confirm?

samir: 👍 i can take it. i'll review PR #842 tonight but it's not blocking the panel — if anything looks off i'll add comments.

people-ops-bot: reminder set — 2:00 PM panel: "Backend Infra Senior — Candidate A". Debrief form will be attached to the event.

michael: tiny prep note to the panel: please lean on tracing/observability question from rubric section 3. paste this agenda in chat if helpful:
```Agenda:
1) 5m intros
2) 30m system design (tracing focus)
3) 20m implementation deep-dive
4) 10m debrief/qs
```

anya: copying agenda into the panel doc. @elaine can you add the resume to the calendar invite and share with scribe?

elaine: done — shared resume in #hiring-drive: drive.google.com/file/d/1ResumeA.pdf

samir: got the resume, thanks. i'll skim on the way to the room and flag anything notable in the PR thread. if i'm blocked by deploy i'll message here and @michael can step in.

calendar-bot: event updated — "Backend Infra Senior - Candidate A" now includes debrief form and drive attachment.

elaine: one more thing — candidate has a 45m constraint. is it ok to mark the whiteboard question optional?

michael: yes, mark whiteboard as optional and treat it as "nice-to-have" on the debrief. focus on implementation plus debugging questions.

elaine: perfect. thanks everyone :heart: 

samir: will ping if anything changes. good luck to the candidate later!
